messages:
inc-bot: ALERT: [P1] prod-inference latency SLO breach detected on cluster inference-prod. p99=6.4s, p95=1.2s. Multiple streaming stalls reported. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/abc/inference-overview?orgId=1

alex (oncall): ack. I'm on it, paging runtime + ml. Running quick health checks.

jordan (sre): looking. Any single-region spike or global?

inc-bot: Affected region: us-west-2 primarily, some spillover us-east-1. Error rate stable, but request processing time increased. Alert fired at 2025-10-08T02:21:50Z.

alex (oncall): @maria @lee can you join? streaming stalls = user-visible stalls where server stops sending chunks for >2s. If this is tokenizer/preproc we should be able to mitigate quickly.

maria (eng-runtime): joining. grabbing tail logs from inference-prod.

jordan (sre): grabbing traces from jaeger. First-pass shows long "preprocess_request" spans 300-700ms in a lot of traces and a few "tokenize" spans at 1.8-3.2s. Most high-latency traces originate from the tokenizer service on node group token-worker-*.

lee (ml): that smells like prompt/template expansion or JSON-mode validation on each request. We've seen JSON schema validation being expensive when tool schemas are long. Did anyone push new prompt templates recently?

alex (oncall): support reports 5 customers with degraded streaming. Sam, can you get a short customer impact list?

sam (support): AcmeCorp (chat product), BetaApp (summaries), Internal /demo dashboard. Impact: increased time-to-first-chunk and some timeouts at client side. I'm sending a status update to those customers now.

maria (eng-runtime): quick grep in the service shows a recent deploy (2025-10-08T01:45Z) to tokenizer that added `validate_tools_json()` call for every request. Example slow stack (from logs):
```
2025-10-08T02:18:12Z [INFO] request_id=... preprocess_request start
2025-10-08T02:18:13Z [DEBUG] request_id=... validate_tools_json -> schema_validate(schema=~15KB)
2025-10-08T02:18:15Z [ERROR] request_id=... tokenize took 2100ms
```
This matches the traces.

lee (ml): yikes — that `schema_validate` runs full JSON schema validation with remote refs per request. Should have been cached. If it's re-parsing the tool schema and compiling regexes per-request that's the source.

alex (oncall): mitigation options: 1) flip feature flag to disable JSON-mode / tool validation on prod path, 2) route a portion of traffic to fallback lighter model (smaller variant) to reduce preprocessing, 3) rollback tokenizer deploy. Which is fastest?

maria (eng-runtime): fastest is feature flag toggle. We can set `validate_tools_json=false` for the prod route in ~20s via the feature flag API. Rollback will take longer because of canary and consistency of state. Routing to fallback model requires routing-policy change and may affect accuracy.

jordan (sre): agree toggle flag. Also increase tokenizer worker pool from 8 -> 16 as short-term to reduce queueing. I'll run the scaling on the node group.

alex (oncall): go ahead. maria do flag, jordan scale workers, lee prepare a quick patch to cache compiled schema+regex globally. sam keep customers updated that we're mitigating. I'll coordinate.

maria (eng-runtime): executing flag toggle now.
```
# curl -X PATCH https://config.redwood.internal/flags/prod-inference -d '{"validate_tools_json":false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
```

maria (eng-runtime): response 200. Flag set. Pushing to rollout=true on route inference-prod.

inc-bot: ACTION: feature flag change applied by maria (eng-runtime).

jordan (sre): scaling tokenizer nodegroup: `gcloud compute instance-groups managed resize token-worker-group --size 16` -> started. CPU pressure should drop in ~90s.

lee (ml): immediate low-effort patch in repo ml/tokenizer: move schema parsing to module import time and keep compiled validators in LRU cache. I'll open PR but won't merge during incident. Patch diff (concept):
```
- def validate_tools(schema, payload):
-     validator = jsonschema.Draft7Validator(schema)
-     return validator.validate(payload)
+ # at module load
+ _compiled_validators = {}
+ def get_validator(schema_key, schema):
+     if schema_key not in _compiled_validators:
+         _compiled_validators[schema_key] = jsonschema.Draft7Validator(schema)
+     return _compiled_validators[schema_key]
```
This avoids repeated compile overhead.

maria (eng-runtime): metrics now showing p99 dropping: was 6.4s -> 2.1s within 90s after flag. p95 ~ 0.8s. Streaming stalls reduced significantly.

alex (oncall): good. keep monitoring for 15m. jordan, confirm tokenizer backpressure cleared.

jordan (sre): token-worker CPU normalized after scale and flag change. Queue depth down from 420 -> 30. No new high-latency traces in last 2 minutes.

sam (support): customer update sent: we applied a mitigation and are monitoring; next update in 30m or earlier if resolved. Customers asked for root-cause ETA.

alex (oncall): preliminary RCA: recent tokenizer deploy introduced per-request heavy JSON schema validation (no caching). Combined with a moderate traffic spike it caused worker queueing -> tail latency and streaming stalls. Impact: P1 SLO breach for ~18 minutes, affected 5 customers with increased TTF.

lee (ml): next steps for postmortem: PR to add persistent validator cache, add unit tests, add perf test for prompt templates including tool schema sizes, and add a lint rule to flag per-request schema compilation. Also add a canary gate to catch 10% deploys that increase preprocess time >50ms.

maria (eng-runtime): operational follow-ups: revert flag->true after patch and verification, or keep flag off until patch is rolled out. I recommend keep disabled and ship patch in morning deploy; will create rollout plan.

alex (oncall): Agree keep flag off until patch is in. I'm going to hand off monitoring to jordan for the overnight window. I'll prepare the incident summary and start the postmortem doc.

jordan (sre): taking over monitoring. I'll watch p99, queue depth and streaming stalls channel. If anything regresses, page me @jordan.

inc-bot: INCIDENT: state moved to MITIGATED by alex (oncall). Severity downgraded to P2. Paging closed at 2025-10-08T02:41:07Z.

alex (oncall): Thanks all. sam once we have the postmortem link can you share to the affected customers with a short note.

sam (support): will do.

lee (ml): opened tracking issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ml/issues/872 - "Cache compiled tool schema validators + perf tests"

maria (eng-runtime): creating deploy PR for safe change and will coordinate with lee's PR to re-enable flag after canary.

alex (oncall): Handoff note for jordan: watch p99 < 1s goal, queue depth < 50, streaming stalls metric < 1/min. If reoccurs, escalate to oncall lead and follow rollback plan in runbook: https://redwood.docs/runbooks/inference-tail-latency.md

jordan (sre): copy that, taking over.

inc-bot: Thread closed from paging perspective. Incident record ID: INC-2025-1008-42.

alex (oncall): I'll finish the timeline and add the tokenizer logs + config diff to the postmortem draft. Will assign owners for fixes. Good catch all.
